name: Funding Wire
description: Worldwide startup funding reports, with disclosed investors and original sources.

store.tagline: Worldwide startup funding reports — who raised, who backed them, with original sources.
store.description:
Funding Wire is a reading-focused feed of startup funding news from around the world, built entirely from public sources. Each report shows the company, the amount raised, the round or stage, the disclosed investors, and the publication date — with links straight back to the original articles so you can read the source yourself.

Search by company or investor, filter by region, stage, or sector, and sort by the latest reports or by the highest raise (compared in approximate US dollars using recent reference rates, with the original currency always shown). Save the companies you care about to keep their reports handy and watch for future rounds.

The feed refreshes daily from public RSS sources, with each new report verified against its publisher evidence before it appears. Coverage is uneven and never exhaustive, details that a source doesn't establish stay marked as unknown, and round amounts are kept distinct from valuations and individual investor contributions. There is no paid data subscription.

Your saved companies and your feed stay private to your Möbius.
